scope: Independent integration contract checks; canvas stub tests are not visual or perceptual acceptance.

tests.name: Native windows are bounded independently before union; A4/B3 span1
Fractional windows retain source-linked carry-ins, not invented observations
Native and aligned clocks use the same retained evidence, with independent translations
An unavailable observed-event anchor blocks aligned history without native substitution
Same-time pre/post action events are separate ordered prefixes
Future suffix state, segments and outcome cannot change a prior effective view
Evidence resolver and compilation share one immutable retained snapshot and trace revision
Missing evidence remains explicit; missing identity arrays are rejected
Save/restore rejects changed versions, missing revisions and any changed effective computation
Strict state validation rejects silent coercion or camera clamping; render config is exported config
Renderer programmatic cameras reject invalid values and generic encoding is actually consumed
Solo A and B use equal materials; fitting changes only one shared camera
